name: kazi-legal-za
description: Grounds your firm's own Claude in your live Kazi data over a read-only MCP connection: drafts monthly fee notes from unbilled time, runs section 86 trust-reconciliation checks, reviews FICA/KYC gaps, briefs matter status, and triages new-matter intake. Tuned for South African legal practice. Every output is a draft for attorney review, committed back in Kazi by hand.
